a.description: np.ndarray The array whose axes should be reordered.

source.description: int or sequence of int Original positions of the axes to move. These must be unique.
constraints: length is positive, elements are in range [0, rank(a))

destination.description: int or sequence of int Destination positions for each of the original axes. These must also be unique.
constraints: length is equal to source's length, elements are in range [0, rank(a))

output.description: ------- np.ndarray Array with moved axes. This array is a view of the input array.
